title: Body-Grounded Replanning for Physically Adaptive Manipulation
summary: Manipulation requires not only reasoning about the external environment, but also about the robot's physical condition. A strategy may remain geometrically feasible while becoming physically unsuitable due to increased joint load or limited mobility, yet internal physical state is typically used only for low-level control. We propose body-grounded high-level replanning, which uses internal physical state to adapt manipulation strategies during execution. Body-state events trigger strategy replan
displayTitle: Body-Grounded Replanning：让机器人按身体状态重规划动作
narrative: 今日 arxiv cs.RO 上 Body-Grounded Replanning 论文指出当前 manipulation 任务只关心外部环境，忽略了机器人自身物理状态——一个动作在几何上仍然可行，但关节负载增加 / 关节活动度下降后就不应该再执行。论文提出把机器人物理状态接入 replanning 决策，让动作选择对"机器人的身体状态"敏感。对所有做长期部署的机器人公司是利好——机器人老化、负载变化是真实痛点；对人形机器人是结构性利好——人形机器人的负载 / 关节数都远高于工业机械臂，"按身体状态重规划"的需求更强；对 NVIDIA / 国产 GPU 厂商是中性——计算负载会增加但可控。这是一篇把"机器人自我感知"做深的论文。
